content.short: TITLES is a creative studio for making images with AI models trained by real artists, who get paid.
content.description: TITLES lets people create images with custom AI models trained by real artists, and pays those artists when others build on their work. It is one of the better-known projects linking generative AI to on-chain creator royalties, and it runs a mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: TITLES lets you create with artist-trained AI models that pay the artists, with a World App mini app.
